title: The essay editor is a shift: elsewhere types and fields carry the structure, here the focus is the writing experience and sovereignty (2026-11-06)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
The essay editor is a shift in our exploration.
In other environments we are not using rich text because we want to maintain the data structure. Srs allows us to establish structured types which, when used, means that we don't need rich text. Markdown is used only for simple text, fields used for the rest. 

The essay currently only offers paragraph types. This is a different kind of context and a different user profile. 

Our focus for this work is currently the writing experience and sovereignty, so here we are looking at how we can offer an editor experience.
